item.title: Hazardous waste, 4th August
item.description:
There has been an escalation in the amount of harmful waste being dumped in the alleyway at the back of Buckingham Avenue including cooking oil and nitrous oxide cylinders. Other waste is also accumulating to the extent that I am concerned of potential fire risk and vermin. Fires have happened in the past where kids have set fire to a moped. This issue has been getting worse over recent months. There are a number of rental properties that back onto the alleyway as well as fast food outlets so not sure who is responsible.

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): 21,23, Falconwood Parade, Falconwood, Greater London
Report on FixMyStreet
